objects.taxonomy_description: Fabric bag with two parallel shoulder straps for carrying on the back. The main compartment is a rectangular or rounded pouch (30-55 cm tall) made of nylon, canvas, or polyester with a zipper or drawstring closure. Materials range from smooth synthetic fabric to textured canvas. Colors vary widely. The bag exhibits bilateral symmetry with straps positioned symmetrically on the back panel.

objects.taxonomy_description: The term 'cooky' refers to a baked food item, distinct from living organisms or inanimate objects like backpacks.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a small, flattened, and typically round or irregular shape consistent with a single serving of baked dough.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The surface appears dry, crumbly, or slightly porous, lacking the smooth skin of fruits or the fibrous texture of raw materials.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The object displays uniform golden-brown to dark-brown hues resulting from the Maillard reaction during baking.

objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.
